title: dmri_bset
description: This tool extracts a subset of volumes, b-values, and gradient directions from a diffusion MRI data set.

bsort.description: Reorder output data by b-shell (default: maintain original order)
bsort.title: B-shell sort flag

bmax.description: Extract all b-values less than or equal to a maximum
bmax.title: B-value maximum

input_b_table.description: Input b-value table (default: input DWI base, .bvals extension)
input_b_table.title: Input b-value table

input_g_table.description: Input gradient table (default: input DWI base, .bvecs extension)
input_g_table.title: Input gradient table

output_b_table.description: Output b-value table (default: output DWI base, .bvals extension)
output_b_table.title: Output b-value table

output_g_table.description: Output gradient table (default: output DWI base, .bvecs extension)
output_g_table.title: Output gradient table
